name: us023-gated-move-with-field-default
description: 023, Phase 9, US7 (rule M4, FR-006): a project's field_defaults happens to record a value for a field of the SAME logical name (Resolution) as the gated transition's required field — the gated warning is byte-identical to the no-field_defaults case, proving the value is never substituted for the demanded field. Byte-identical across ports.

content.text: We need to prove a recorded field_defaults value is never substituted for a gated field of the same name.
As a user, I want the first capability.
**Given** a starting state **When** the user acts **Then** the first outcome happens
